what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Jordan in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3690 Jordanian asylum seekers in the United States, 34.4% of all asylum seekers from Jordan.
Refugees from Jordan, a separate group, live mostly in Canada, Germany, the United States and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Jordan: with the Islamic State group in 2016.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Jordan.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 319 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 6507, at the end of 2024; the main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
